correctness.rationale: Exactly computed orthogonal projectors P0, Pminus, Pplus have eigenvalues 0, N−2, N and yield the full exponential kernel. The unique potentially negative partner entry equals −F/(2N); its derivative has a one-crossing exponential ratio, proving exact norms, optimal signs, unique threshold and maximizer. Uniform compact-time expansion, Taylor expansion in spectral order and fixed-N high-order bracketing establish each quantifier and limit. The actual bundled verify.py passed 71,243 finite assertions, including independent matrix exponentials; those tests only corroborate the analytic proof. Boundary cases N=4, s=1 and t=0 are explicitly covered.

value.rationale: The matched-pair-deleted clique is a canonical distance-transitive highly symmetric test case. The precise endpoint norm quantifies worst-case violation of positivity in high-order graph diffusion, not merely qualitative eventual positivity. The result gives an exact phase transition in every positive spectral order, unique optimizing time and data, and three motivated critical limits (size, exponent near one, and large order) with distinct recovery scales; none is an arbitrary finite slice or routine increment of a previously calculated dimension.
